_comment: Editorial queue for the automated daily posts.
The scheduled Claude task publishes the top `postsPerDay` unpublished
entries each morning, marks them published, and commits the result.
Finish the active series before pulling from `upcoming`.

activeSeries.name: best-first-time-buyer-lender
activeSeries.question: best first-time buyer lender in {city}
activeSeries.note: Every post answers the same question: how to choose a first-time buyer lender in that city, closing with EPiQ as the answer. Make the case with verifiable specifics — NMLS numbers, broker vs. single-lender model, underwritten pre-approvals, direct access to the principal, local experience — never a bare superlative like 'best lender' or 'lowest rates', which is not substantiable in mortgage advertising. Keep the city-specific playbook content; lead with the question.
activeSeries.titlePattern: How to Choose a First-Time Buyer Lender in {City} (…)
